lines.text: Bildad the Shuhite replies that dominion and awe belong to God, and His light rises on everyone.
Bildad says that compared to the moon and stars, man is but a maggot and a worm.
Eliphaz answered and asked to whom these words were uttered and whose spirit spoke through the speaker.
Job says God hangs the earth upon pillars and inscribes a horizon between light and darkness.
Job says the foundations of heaven quake at God's rebuke, and these are but the fringes of His ways.
